bio.text: Eliott Rodriguez is the Democratic nominee for Florida's 27th Congressional District in the November 3, 2026 general election.
WLRN describes him as a former CBS4 anchorman and reported in March 2026 that he retired from the station in December.
WLRN reported that his parents were Cuban immigrants who brought him from New York to grow up in Miami in the 1960s.
His campaign website says he spent forty years telling South Florida's story.

sources.title: Ex-anchorman Eliott Rodriguez will run for María Elvira Salazar's Miami congressional seat
